title: WriteAccess::Checking/Allowing has no lost-request sweep (emoji Granting, phone and data sends do)
trigger: A mini app calls web_app_request_write_access; canBotSendMessages/allowBotToSendMessages leaves flight with no answer (stale sweep or reconnect)
effect: The app never hears write_access_requested and every later request gets 'false' (busy) until the mini app window is closed
fix: Add the same requests.get(request).is_none() check in poll_emoji_status style, ending Checking/Allowing with a false reply

title: Widget runtime thread is not panic-guarded; a panic leaves the entry in Loading/Running forever
trigger: A widget's display list or font/canvas code panics on the quill-widget thread (thread::run is a bare std::thread, only FFI callbacks are guarded)
effect: The thread ends silently, no Failed/Stopped event is sent, inbox sends are dropped; the bubble keeps the placeholder or last frame (looks live, never responds) until the widget is shed or replaced
fix: Spawn with thread_guard::spawn_guarded and publish RuntimeEvent::Failed when the thread ends without Inbox::Stop
